global.projection: three-quarter isometric strategic-map perspective compatible with current Fortress, Bridge and Octarina
global.variant_rule: Faction/damage variants must preserve the approved neutral landmark silhouette and footprint; variants may alter banners, materials, damage state and faction accents, but must not become different structures.
global.art_language: premium medieval-fantasy strategic-map world art; authored physical object, not app UI; strong material definition; restrained effects; no glow-heavy tech styling

city.required_read: a real settlement/city cluster and inhabited place

silhouette.hierarchy: one civic focal building plus smaller houses/workshops around streets or a small plaza
silhouette.footprint: broad and clustered rather than tall and singular

authored_details: vegetation or small perimeter dressing integrated into the footprint
clear ground contact and entrance direction
city.neutral_palette: warm stone, timber and restrained roof variation; no dominant blue/red faction coding

mine.required_read: a constructed extraction site with a usable mine entrance

silhouette.hierarchy: dark mine portal embedded in terrain plus timber/stone extraction structures
silhouette.footprint: compact industrial landmark with horizontal extraction cues

authored_details: timber beams or stone retaining structure
excavated ground/rock face integrated into the footprint
mine.neutral_palette: stone, timber, iron and earth; no dominant blue/red faction coding

required_before_variants: City neutral silhouette approved at gameplay scale
Mine neutral silhouette approved at gameplay scale
both assets have transparent world-space renders
no semantic substitute or UI-like treatment
final_hoc_acceptance: successor PACK runtime registry contains canonical IDs
Living Map resolves City and Mine without query hacks
Fortress, Bridge and Octarina remain unchanged
